test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book 'AIIMS Mein Ek Jung Ladte Hue'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramesh Pokhriyal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'AIIMS Mein Ek Jung Ladte Hue'** is a book written by **Ramesh Pokhriyal 'Nishank'.**
 
• Ramesh Pokhriyal 'Nishank' is the **former Union Minister of Education** of India.
 
• It was written by him while **he was battling COVID-19 at AIIMS in Delhi. **
 
• The book was published by **Prabhat Prakashan Pvt. Ltd.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **All information as of Apr 2022:**

 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman** is the current **Minister of Finance** **of India.**
 
• **Piyush Goyal** is a Cabinet Minister of the Government of India having portfolios such as **Minister of Textiles, Minister of Commerce and Industry, and Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.**
 
• **Nitin Gadkari **is the current **Minister for Road Transport & Highways of India.**
